featureImplementation.description: Automatic notification system for listings on sale 30+ days without being marked as sold

componentsCreated.purpose: Modal UI for displaying and managing old listings
features: Header with count of old listings
Scrollable listing cards with image thumbnails
Price, title, type badge, and days-old calculation
Three action buttons: Keep Active, Mark as Sold, Delete
Dark theme styling with Tailwind CSS

componentsCreated.implementation: Automatic detection on user login with 2-second delay, session-based notification tracking

modalDisplay.checkpoint: Modal appears when user has 30+ day old unsold listings
requirements: Verify modal displays with correct listing count

actionButtons.checkpoint: All three action buttons function correctly

buttons.name: Keep Active
buttons.action: Removes listing from notification, keeps it active
buttons.verification: Listing removed from modal, remains in user's listings

buttons.name: Mark as Sold
buttons.action: Updates listing status to sold in database
buttons.verification: Database updated, listing removed from modal, refreshed list shows sold status

buttons.name: Delete
buttons.verification: Confirmation dialog appears, listing deleted after confirmation, removed from database

sessionTracking.checkpoint: Notification only shows once per session
verification: Refresh page - modal should NOT reappear
Log out and back in - modal should reappear in new session
Test with multiple old listings of same type
Test with mixed types (cue, case, table, accessory)
Verify count badge updates as listings are processed

errorHandling.checkpoint: Graceful error handling in all scenarios
scenarios: API failure during mark as sold

nextSteps: 1. Log in with test account that has 30+ day old listings
2. Verify modal appears immediately after login
3. Test 'Keep Active' button - listing should remain
4. Test 'Mark as Sold' button - listing should be updated in DB
5. Test 'Delete' button - listing should be removed with confirmation
6. Test with multiple listing types simultaneously
7. Test session tracking - refresh page without logging out
8. Log out and back in to verify session reset
9. Test error scenarios with network issues
10. Monitor console for any errors or warnings
testRecords.notes: Feature fully implemented and deployed. Ready for comprehensive QA testing across all listing types and edge cases.
